name: Matrix IT Ltd.
summary: Matrix IT Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) solutions and services in Israel, the United States, and Europe. It operates in four segments: Information Technology Solutions and Services, Consulting, and Management in Israel; Information Technology Solutions and Services in the United States; Sale, Marketing, and Support of Software Products; and Cloud and Computing Infrastructures.
